business_summary: Bloomage BioTechnology Corporation Limited researchers, develops, produces, and sells bioactive materials. It also provides pharma and aesthetics; nutrition and health products under the brand Hyatrue; Bloomecto; Bloomcolla; BloomseaN; BloomStem; MitoEGT L-Ergothioneine; UltraHA J Sodium Hyaluronate; MitoPQQ Pyrroloquinoline Quinone Disodium; UltraHA-CWS Sodium Hyaluronate; HAPLEX Plus Sodium Hyaluronate; Gabarelax Gamma Aminobutyric Acid; UltraHA-GI-001 Special sodium hyaluronate for gut health; and Biovivid Collagen Peptide name. Bloomage BioTechnology Corporation Limited was founded in 2000 and is based in Jinan, China.
